C04 and C10 are earlier iterations of the same recurring text, but C07 is the closest and most plausible direct template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Section 202(d) of the National Emergencies Act ... provides for the automatic termination of a national emergency unless ... the President publishes in the Federal Register and transmits to the Congress a notice stating that the emergency is to continue in effect beyond the anniversary date.","parent_excerpt":"Section 202(d) of the National Emergencies Act ... provides for the automatic termination of a national emergency unless ... the President publishes in the Federal Register and transmits to the Congress a notice stating that the emergency is to continue in effect beyond the anniversary date.","explanation":"The statutory explanation and notification machinery are reproduced verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"the emergency declared with respect to grave acts of violence committed by foreign terrorists that disrupt the Middle East peace process is to continue in effect beyond January 23, 2001","parent_excerpt":"the emergency declared with respect to grave acts of violence committed by foreign terrorists that disrupt the Middle East peace process is to continue in effect beyond January 23, 2000","explanation":"The same operative continuation sentence is reused with only the annual date advanced."},{"child_excerpt":"The crisis ... has not been resolved. Terrorist groups continue to engage in activities that have the purpose or effect of threatening the Middle East peace process ... Such actions threaten vital interests of the national security, foreign policy, and economy of the United States. On August 20, 1998, I identified four additional persons, including Usama bin Ladin","parent_excerpt":"The crisis ... has not been resolved. On August 20, 1998, I identified four additional persons, including Usama bin Ladin","explanation":"The child retains the same sequence of factual findings and the distinctive reference to the four additional persons and Usama bin Ladin."},{"child_excerpt":"For these reasons, I have determined that it is necessary to maintain in force the broad authorities necessary to deny any financial support from the United States for foreign terrorists who threaten to disrupt the Middle East peace process.","parent_excerpt":"For these reasons, I have determined that it is necessary to maintain in force the broad authorities necessary to deny any financial support from the United States for foreign terrorists who threaten to disrupt the Middle East peace process.","explanation":"The concluding determination and substantive administrative purpose are identical."}]}
